_comment: Canonical BNB Smart Chain testnet (chainId 97) per-asset risk params. JSON is the single source of truth for deploy + front + sim + docs.

_network.name: BNB Smart Chain Testnet
_network.note: Chapel is Binance's internal codename for BSC testnet — same chain as chainId 97.

_units.minFeeBps: PBPS on-chain (Asset.minFeeBps). 100 PBPS = 1 bp = 0.01%. 1 PBPS = 0.0001% = 0.01 bp. Protocol floor: MIN_FEE_PBPS = 1.

stable-core._paramNote: SIM-TUNED (faithful 3mo state-machine replay of 11.5M BSC swaps; prime/research/stable-core/RISK_PARAMS_TESTNET.md + stable_report.html). minFeeBps=100 (1bp spread) is the LP<->trader EQUILIBRIUM: wins ~23% of trades / ~12% of volume (sane, non-toxic flow) at ~11-15% LP net APR. Lower starves LPs (0.5bp->8% APR, 0.3bp->5%), higher sheds trader share (1.5bp->18% win). Floor is 1 PBPS (0.01bp) — reserved for a price war via setAssetParams, NOT the launch value; on stables σ is too small to lift a 1-PBPS floor off the floor. θ=0.3bp = the CRITICAL LP-protection knob: fresh marks keep the pool at true peg so it takes balanced flow (rebalancing stays ~2-4% of won volume, LVR ~0). ~800 pushes/day, ~$60/mo. Coverage band is NOT load-bearing (covMin 0.5..0.8 all equivalent in sim) — freshness is. All 5 priced off Pyth (see priceFeeds).

depositCapScheduleUsd._comment: Testnet growth schedule $50K->$1M. Per-asset split = observed 3mo stable-stable volume weights (base USDC 35%, USDT 26%, USD1 27%, FDUSD 8.5%, USDe 3.5%). USDe kept tiny (near-0 BSC flow + depeg risk). Raise the active tier via setAssetParams as TVL fills; win-share by count (~23%) is TVL-invariant, volume-share and abs fees scale up ($8k/yr@50K -> $111k/yr@1M).

priceFeeds._comment: Keeper reads Pyth Hermes off-chain per token → pushes to ExternalOracle (deviation-θ + heartbeat + on-chain EMA). Pyth is the SOURCE, not on the quote path. All 5 verified live on Pyth (BSC contract 0x4D7E825f80bDf85e913E0DD2A2D54927e9dE1594). USD1 = young token, quiet Pyth add — monitor conf/heartbeat, NX-Rates fallback ready.
priceFeeds.usd1Fallback: NX-Rates feed if Pyth conf/heartbeat degrades (young token)

feeFloorsHuman.note: On-chain quantum is 1 PBPS (MIN_FEE_PBPS = 0.01 bp). Sub-1 bp quotes enabled at σ=0 on all classes. Production minFee may be raised via setAssetParams (e.g. 2·θ LVR sizing).
